# Minmetals East

> > Minmetals East manufactures and supplies advanced silica, silicone, thermal insulation, and sealant materials for industrial applications across 50+ countries.

Henan Minmetals East Industrial Co., Ltd. operates four business divisions specializing in silicon materials (fumed silica, organic silicon, TEOS), thermal insulation products (aerogel, VIP panels, ceramic fiber), sealants and adhesives, and refractory materials. The company serves global markets with branded products including HJSIL®, MESIL®, and METHERM®.

- [TEOS](https://www.minmetalseast.com/product/silicon-materials/inorganic-silicon): TEOS inorganic silicon product page for industrial chemical applications.
- [Thermal Insulation Materials: Aerogel, VIP, Ceramic Fiber | Minmetals East](https://www.minmetalseast.com/product/adiabatic-materials/thermal-insulation-products): Thermal insulation products including aerogel, VIP panels, and ceramic fiber materials.
